assets.name: Inline rendering
assets.caption: A heading, bold and italic, inline code, a link and strikethrough — rendered in place, with the markdown still the document.

assets.name: Syntax reveal
assets.caption: The caret inside the bold node brings its ** delimiters back. Nothing is hidden from you; nothing was converted into a separate model.

assets.name: Host widgets
assets.caption: The @gabe mention chip and the callout block are drawn by the host app, from a declarative manifest the core never executes.

assets.name: Resolved references
assets.caption: The document holds a 26-character path, never the bytes. The host resolves the chart and the spec.pdf chip off disk.

assets.name: iOS walkthrough
assets.caption: Caret in, syntax back, caret out — then down through the host widgets to the resolved references.

assets.name: macOS editor
assets.caption: The same document in the AppKit host — one Swift package, two renderers, the same decoration logic underneath.

assets.name: macOS widgets and references
assets.caption: The mention chip, the callout block, the resolved chart and the spec.pdf chip, all drawn natively by the host.
